preconditions.description: The number of knitting needles in the sculpture is between 1 and 50000, inclusive.
The coordinates of each triple are integers between 1 and 999, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output_line_1 in {'True closed chains', 'No true closed chains'}
postconditions.description: The first line of output indicates whether there is a true closed chain in the sculpture.

postconditions.expression: output_line_2 in {'Floor closed chains', 'No floor closed chains'}
postconditions.description: The second line of output indicates whether there is a floor closed chain in the sculpture.
